chapter: The Grid (levels 71-80, the neon wireframe world of mathematical solids) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (the owner, 2026-10-11, #824): a lead line the ear can follow, its identity in the mid range, the drive carried by arrangement rather than by noise and sub bass; the family's electronic dance root kept
purpose: Master of Game/Music/pulse-electrofunk.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-824-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate in masters-824); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-pulse.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Retro-futuristic 1980s electro-funk instrumental for a neon wireframe world of glowing geometric shapes: a funky slap bass guitar riff you can hum, a warm, catchy analog synth lead melody carried in the mid range, funky muted rhythm guitar, warm clavinet and synth-brass stabs answering the lead, a tight funky drum-machine groove of kick, snare and toms with a dark ride cymbal playing throughout, a middle section where the slap bass and the guitar carry on under a second melody before the lead returns, building into a big groovy peak with warm wide synth chords, playful, robotic and cool, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, no vocals
request.lm_negative_prompt: vocals, singing, choir, humming, sampled vocal chops, vocoder, talk box, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, comedy, cartoon, silly, childish, cute, sugary, toy piano, music box, ambient drone, free tempo, rubato, long quiet intro, long silent passages, boomy sub bass, 808 sub bass, deep sub bass, rumble, distorted bass, growling bass, wobble bass, white noise, noise sweeps, risers, hiss, glitch, siren synths, industrial noise, bright supersaw, fizzy synths, sizzling high synth leads, airy shimmer, sparkling high chimes, bright crash cymbals, splashy cymbals, cymbal wash, open hi-hats, sizzling hi-hats, bright hand claps, tambourine, shakers, snare rolls, long drum-only sections, drum solo, harsh dissonance, quiet breakdown, near silence, long soft passages, fade out, fade in, long soft intro, droning, one-note bass, 808 cowbell, robotic voice, breakbeat

Still outside ember: 2.58 held-note changes/s (ember at least 2.74; old 2.95): the eight other seeds of the same brief put 2.1-11.3 % above 6 kHz
chosen.how: every candidate measured with Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember in one run (band shares, tonal mid, mid flatness, held-note changes, tempo wander, wrap step) beside the loop cut's own check, the hole share (the loop more than 10 dB under its loud level), the breakdown dip and the stereo correlation; a seam below its own rhythm, a hole over 15 %, a 2 s dropout more than 20 dB down, a wrap step of 10 dB or more or at or above p97 of the loop's own steps, a seam spectrum cosine under 0.3 or a loop under 30 s ruled a candidate out; the table is on #824
